overall_assessment: Extraction works well for HiOF: all 8 fetched pages contain the full plan (facts box, learning outcomes, teaching, assessment, requirements, literature) with clean structure and no navigation or junk; the only uncaptured text is the breadcrumb. Remaining issues are a high 404 rate (about half of offerings) and recent plans whose reading list is only a Leganto pointer.

findings.evidence: Gjeldende litteraturliste for 2025 Vår finner du i Leganto
findings.description: For newer plans (2023-2025) the reading list on the page is only a pointer to the external Leganto system, so the extracted text has no literature. Older plans (2020-2021) list the literature in full. This is a source limitation, not a selector error, but it makes reading_list systematically empty for recent years.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: HiOF moved reading lists to Leganto; the FS page carries only the link sentence.
findings.suggested_fix: Treat the Leganto pointer sentence as a placeholder in section extraction (no reading_list content) and note in data_notes.qmd that reading lists are missing for recent HiOF plans; no change to extraction.

findings.evidence: Gjeldende litteraturliste for 2024 Høst finner du i Leganto
findings.description: The 2025 Høst plan refers to the 2024 Høst reading list, so the page's own pointer names a different year than the offering. Probably an error in the source page, but the text is a faithful copy.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Source page content (FS), not the pipeline.
findings.suggested_fix: No pipeline change; do not use the year in the Leganto sentence for year validation.

findings.description: 866 of 1712 offerings (about half) return 404. The packet shows one failed course, with a URL of the same form (lusp/lusp/2024/var) as the successful 2021-2025 pages, so some may be courses not offered that year, but the high rate warrants a check that the URL builder does not miss a path variant (older years use historiske-emner/lu).
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/add_course_url.R builds both lusp/lusp and historiske-emner/lu paths; some offerings may be in the wrong branch or not exist (generated offerings for years/semesters where the course was not given).
findings.suggested_fix: Cross-check the 404 offerings against the course list: for each 404 try the alternate path and confirm the course was offered that year; drop offerings that are confirmed absent from the frame.
